_readme: Item ids are the wire contract with sarko-api (stash_items.item_id). Never rename an id that a player's stash may already hold. bike_frame / wheel_small / chain are copied verbatim from sarko-api/internal/domain/garage.go's bicycle recipe. Task 2 mirrors this list into internal/domain/loot.go, and a Go test reads this file to catch drift. `consumable` is the category you can TAP in your own grid to use (spec §4); canned_food and vodka moved into it from `valuable`, and water_bottle is new. size is [width, height] in whole cells and is REQUIRED; the table is spec 2026-08-05 §1.1 and Sarko.Loot.ItemSizesMatchTheDesignTable holds both halves of it.
_readme_slot: `slot` is AUTHORED, not derived from `category`, and it is what the ІНВЕНТАР screen's equipment slots accept (equipment spec §2). Deriving it from the category cannot work in the one place it matters: `backpack` and `jacket` are both `gear`, and a bag is not a coat — the category paints the cell, the slot decides where the cell can go. Legal values: weapon, backpack, clothing. ABSENT means the item is not equipment at all, which is the case for all but three rows, so it is optional in the parser and its absence is a fact rather than a defect. sarko-api/internal/domain/loot.go mirrors it; SarkoEquip::SlotFor is the only reader.
_readme_weapons: `rifle` and `shotgun` were added by the weapon-mesh pass (2026-08-04) and are 3x1 because spec §5 says so: "making the rifle 3 wide is what makes backpacks matter". They are ROWS AND MESHES ONLY — no loot table produces them, no ВИЛАЗКА kit grants them and neither has stats of its own, so nothing about balance moved. Held meshes live in SarkoWeaponVisuals, keyed by these ids. The next task gives them damage, magazines and a way in; until then they are exactly what the pistol was before it had a mesh, minus a way to obtain one.
_readme_short: `short` is the label a GRID CELL draws, and it is AUTHORED, not derived. A 44 pt cell holds about five Cyrillic capitals, and cutting `name` down to fit produced ПАТР…, АПТЕ…, ОБЕЗ…, АРМО…, МЕТА…, МІДН… — nine ellipses on one screen, and two junk greys that both read ЛОМ… are indistinguishable, which is the entire job of the label the hue does not already do. Rules, all held by Sarko.UI.ShortNamesAreAuthoredAndDistinct: present for every item, unique across the catalog, 2..6 characters, no spaces (a cell draws one word). Two is the floor and not three because ПМ is the pistol's real name and padding it would invent a letter. UPPERCASE as authored, because that is how a cell draws it. The Go drift alarm (domain/loot_test.go) reads only id/stackSize/size out of this file, so this field is invisible to it.
